items.message:
High tides today may lead to flooding. 
Flooding is possible from 18:00 to 20:00 on 27/09/2026. 
High tides this evening may lead to flooding.  

Flooding is forecast to affect locations at Porlock Bay, with low lying land and roads expected to be most affected, particularly around the coastline between Gore Point and Hurlstone Point including Porlock Weir. The highest tide is at 19:15 on Sunday 27/09/2026 with a peak height of 6.19m and a F5 westerly wind. 
We are closely monitoring the situation . 
Take care and avoid walking, cycling or driving through flood water . 
This message will be updated by 9:00AM on 28 September 2026 or as the situation changes.

High tides this afternoon may lead to flooding. 
Flooding is possible from 1:30PM to 5:30PM on 27/09/2026. 
Locations most affected will be coastal roads and footpaths, particularly at Beadnell Harbour Road North. 
We are closely monitoring the situation . 
Avoid beaches and coastal promenades, which may be flooded . 
This message will be updated by 7:00PM on 27 September 2026 or as the situation changes.

items.description: The Essex coast from Clacton to and including, St Peters Flat and the Colne and Blackwater estuaries
items.message:
There is no longer a threat of flooding, though standing water and debris may still remain. 
The previous tide of concern has now passed,  the weather is more settled and no flooding is expected.   
We will continue to monitor the situation and will issue further alerts or warnings if necessary.   
Continue to take care on waterside roads and footpaths and don't put yourself in unnecessary danger. Never drive through flood water,  just 30cm of fast flowing water is enough to move your car.
